claims.claim: Before C-7, Quebec permitted non-reasonably-foreseeable MAID via court exemption from 12 Mar 2020; Quebec reported 18 such provisions in 2020.
PM Mark Carney (6 May 2026): will not take a position on mental-illness-only MAID yet — 'I like to take informed positions and I'll wait for the report.'
Justice Minister Sean Fraser (16 Jun 2026, CTV): will not 'close the door' on any MAID policy; 'we have to maintain an open mind' regarding mental-illness expansion.
Criminal Code path still opens mental-disorder-as-sole-condition MAID on 17 Mar 2027 unless amended (C-62 / AMAD Rec.1 pending cabinet response).

CPSO did not escalate MacLean/Dillon concerns to Ontario Physicians and Surgeons Discipline Tribunal; issued caution (remedial, not formal discipline) plus voluntary undertaking: ≥6 months clinical supervision, chart review, education; still licensed to provide MAID.
